rule_or_requirement: On the same new tune cells, qualified finish-line crossing leads comparison; faster finished laps matter only if completion ties.
observable_information: Pixel-only visible road path or curvature/speed bar, fixed controller actions, local finish flags, lap/progress, collisions/damage and runtime latency.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Use unchanged TRAIN-activated path-exit steering or curvature-coupled speed-budget action around the fixed speed-coupled base; no tuning during evaluation.
expected_success_endpoint: At least as many actual finishes as selected full-road-guard across twelve paired cells, followed by a shorter median finished lap on a completion tie.
control: Selected full-road-guard controller, identical source and checkpoint across the twelve cells.
falsifier: Lower finish count, no candidate action activation, invalid action, or equal completion without faster median finished lap.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Three frozen profiles on official tracks 1–3 crossed with untouched tune seeds 2012–2015, 36 total episodes, 2,000 decisions maximum each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local Linux Python 3.11 CPU diagnostic, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1,800 seconds, no site upload, official submission, or model confirmation.
